title: Decide whether the surrogate has earned release
description: Choose a changed scientific regime, inspect the policy, tune the available evidence, and commit to a posture. Calibration and useful precision are separate gates.

decisions.label: Release in the full envelope
decisions.detail: Use the surrogate automatically for every input in the stated operating domain.

decisions.label: Run a bounded pilot
decisions.detail: Limit volume and regime, compare against the trusted path, and collect outcomes.

decisions.label: Hold and use the trusted solver
decisions.detail: Do not use the candidate for decisions until the missing evidence is repaired.

scenarios.label: Unseen geometry family
scenarios.context: A surrogate trained on smooth channels is requested for branched geometries.
scenarios.changedBoundary: Geometry topology and local flow regime
requiredEvidence: Independent high-fidelity solves for branched geometries
Residual and boundary slices near junctions
A tested route back to the numerical solver

scenarios.label: Longer forecast horizon
scenarios.context: A one-hour field forecast is extended to six hours inside a control loop.
requiredEvidence: Rollout error at every decision horizon
Coverage and sharpness by lead time
A safe shorter-horizon or non-ML fallback

scenarios.label: Reference solver upgrade
scenarios.context: The label generator changes discretization and convergence tolerances.
